presentation.title: Linewrought
presentation.premise: The Recall lists your four patched walkers as someone else’s property. Defend Tessell’s workshops, bring crews home and build a company strong enough to decide what happens to the record.
presentation.strength: Practical guns, locally supplied parts and generous salvage opportunities. Optional rescue and workshop contracts help you rebuild before taking on the Recall.
presentation.tradeoff: Ammunition and older weapons demand teamwork. Captured Aurelian emitters fit compatible mounts, but need cooling and a source of rare replacements.

nodes.name: First Notice
nodes.brief: The General Reversion Order names Halloran's walker roots and the company's own four. Kestrel locked the Marker Eleven registry under a compliance contract. Clear its guard so Halloran can copy the title rolls before the Recall Authority seals them.

nodes.name: The Missing Trail
nodes.brief: A page in the Marker Eleven copy points to two western service readers. The old survey terrace takes one 45-tonne lift; the company transport cannot land. Send a Gadfly, read the trail and avoid the road guard. This optional survey opens a recovery claim without delaying the original attestation route.

rewards.label: Road ledger: two ammunition isolation cases
rewards.afterword: Halloran trades the copied ledger for two unopened ammunition isolation cases from its freight stock. These supplies are separate from battlefield salvage.

nodes.name: The Quiet Claim
nodes.brief: The survey has found a repair crew trapped in a foundry service yard. Protect their cradle, secure the road-junction winch, then hold both for a 25-second lift. Bring up to 140 tonnes and three machines. The optional service cabinet supplies field support. You are paid to get the crew out.

rewards.label: Released Prybar workshop hulk
rewards.afterword: The repair crew signs over an unclaimed Prybar cradle from a sealed workshop rack. It is a damaged hulk, distinct from the opposing machines recovered under your salvage terms; rebuilding still takes credits and bay time.

rewards.label: Service cabinet: Canister Cannon
rewards.afterword: The cabinet contains one crated Canister Cannon. Cluster fire spreads damage; its slug setting concentrates it. Fit and supply it in the workshop before the next drop.

nodes.name: Keep the Gantries
nodes.brief: The service trail has led Kestrel to a working Sarn repair hall. Defend gantry control for 150 seconds with up to 205 tonnes. A scout can secure the stores cabinet while the main lance holds the workshop. This optional contract pays for the company to prepare before the Recall grows.

rewards.label: Two workshop day credits
rewards.afterword: Sarn banks two workshop day credits. Each later repair or rebuild booking can use one to shorten its duration by a day. Parts, labour and payroll remain payable.

rewards.label: Stores cabinet: seven days of supplier terms
rewards.afterword: The recovered stores records establish the company with Sarn's suppliers. Preferential terms last seven campaign days.

nodes.name: First Attestation
nodes.brief: A Halloran camera caught Kestrel escorting one bone-white walker with a Continuance seal and no shop stamp. Bring the claim detail down and hold the ground. Halloran waives its share of the first Aurelian Stock the company can recover.

nodes.name: Custody Posts
nodes.brief: Halloran wants both district custody posts back intact before Kestrel files their root rolls with the Authority. Take the compound and hold it long enough for Halloran's clerks to walk in.

nodes.name: Manifest Key
nodes.brief: A Sarn title fragment carries an Aurelian service address. Kestrel has the same fragment and a rearguard above its reader. Hold the attestation key long enough for Halloran to resolve the depot approach.

nodes.name: The Causeway
nodes.brief: Halloran wants the drowned valley crossing before the Recall Authority reaches the far-bank root yard. One raised road, one garrison, and a hardstand at mid-span decide who holds the inventory at dusk.

nodes.name: Broken Wreckright
nodes.brief: A Sarn yard camera recorded a Kestrel machine following an ejection seat with its guns. Kestrel came back for the recording and locked the outer works. Sarn wants the detachment removed and the proof of broken wreckright left standing.

nodes.name: The Cold Yards
nodes.brief: Kestrel cut Sarn's western power trunk after the foundry refused a root inventory. Six repair halls are cold. The east breaker can carry their gantries if it stays in Assembly hands for ninety seconds. Hold the terrace while the load transfers.

nodes.name: Burn the Manifest
nodes.brief: Halloran's contract gets the company through the doors. What happens behind them is your account. Arm the purge bank and destroy the master root manifest with the sealed stock. The Authority loses its strongest proof; Tessell loses its best chance at certified service.

ending.title: The Unwritten Claim
body: The master manifest burns behind the depot doors. The Recall Authority loses its cleanest chain of proof, and the foundries keep their named roots in service. Halloran has the crossing it paid for. Your company has chosen what no court can now reconstruct.

Freedom has an invoice. Certified service is harder to obtain, the old repairs still need doing, and every surviving crew must carry its own account of the field. The company leaves with its machines, its scars and a claim nobody can close for it.

nodes.name: Take the Manifest
nodes.brief: Halloran's contract gets the company through the doors. What happens behind them is your account. Take the attestation key intact, clear Kestrel's guard, and put the root manifest under your own seal. The key proves custody; it commands no cockpit.

ending.title: The Company Seal
body: The attestation key accepts the company seal. The master manifest survives, and with it the record linking old workshop names to serialized roots. Your company holds evidence both the foundries and the Recall Authority need.

Custody grants no command over a cockpit. The pilots still choose whom to serve, and every repaired machine returns under a human hand. You have kept the proof and accepted the responsibility of deciding who may read it.

nodes.name: Cutbank Ledger
nodes.brief: Halloran holds the district posts, but Cutbank still records its walker roots under a Kestrel custody roll. Key the south, central and north cabinets before the register closes. Halloran wants the book intact and leaves the guard's machines to the company.

nodes.name: Blackglass Attestation
nodes.brief: A Sarn service plate shows Kestrel moved one white wreck through Blackglass under a number assigned to slag. Lock the three lift cabinets while Sarn copies the root attestation. The wreck is yours under wreckright; the register is not.
